name: Courier
look: young woman motorbike courier, slim athletic build, full-face black helmet with a dark visor, red leather riding jacket, black trousers, black riding boots, black leather gloves
pose: riding low over the tank of a red motorbike, both hands on the grips; at the start she sits upright waiting, at the end she sits up and looks at the clock tower

name: Bike
look: red sport motorbike, glossy red fairing and tank, black wheels and seat, a bright white headlight, a small black rear rack carrying the glowing package
pose: ridden fast; burns out, weaves, jumps a drawbridge gap, skids round 180 degrees to a stop

name: Package
look: a cube parcel about 45 cm a side that glows warm yellow from inside, strapped to the motorbike's rear rack with two black straps
pose: strapped to the rack the whole time, glowing and gently pulsing

name: SUV
look: large black SUV, gloss black paint, dark tinted windows, bright white headlights
pose: chasing the motorbike; smashes a fruit stall, brakes hard on the rising bridge leaf and drops nose-first into the river

name: SUV driver
look: heavy-set man in a black suit and black sunglasses, seen through the tinted windscreen
pose: both hands on the wheel, leaning forward; braces back when he brakes

name: Clock tower
look: tall pale stone clock tower on a large civic building, four big round white clock faces lit from inside with two black hands, reading 11:59 then 12:00
pose: at the end of the avenue in shot 1, straight beyond the helipad in shot 11; the minute hand clicks to 12 at 28.4 s

name: City
look: small night city at midnight: a narrow alley, a straight avenue with street lamps and light traffic, a street market with fruit stalls and coloured awnings, a river with a bascule drawbridge, a road tunnel with strip lights, a concrete ramp up to a rooftop helipad; a low warm light from the west early on, cool moonlight on the roof
